elevation.$description: Confirmed via Figma variables (Drop shadow/*) and cross-checked against all 5 apps' Tailwind boxShadow config — already identical everywhere, no ratification conflict. Just needed one shared home. ⚠️ Real-usage audit (2026-07-23): in every single app, developers reach for Tailwind's STOCK shadow classes (shadow-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl) alongside — sometimes more than — this named scale (e.g. one app: 65 stock-class uses vs. 41 named-token uses; another: stock shadow-lg alone outnumbers named shadow-large). A CI lint blocking stock shadow-* classes in favor of these named tokens would close a real, consistently observed gap, not a hypothetical one. RESOLVED (2026-07-25): the focus-ring below was reconciled from two competing definitions into one, real one — see its own entry for the full evidence trail.

xsmall.$description: Confirmed repeatedly via named 'Drop shadow/XSmall' variables: Input Field/Box (removed entirely in the Disabled state), and Button Group. Real-usage audit: the most consistently-used named shadow token across all 5 apps.

focus-ring.$description: REPLACED (2026-07-25), by real code evidence over the earlier Figma-sourced value: a 2026-07-25 audit of all 5 apps found the previous #E1E1FE solid 4px ring has ZERO real usage anywhere in any codebase (`grep -rni E1E1FE` across all 5 apps' src/ returns nothing). Meanwhile a translucent primary-500-at-12%-alpha, 3px, no-blur ring (`rgba(53,61,215,0.12)`) is a real, repeated, consistent implementation across 2 live apps (recruitment-portal: 4 files: TagInput, SalaryRangeSection, PillSelect, JobGeneratedContent; client-web: 3 identical instances sharing the same Jobs feature code) plus a near-variant in career-web's LoginForm (same shape/alpha/spread, indigo-600 instead of primary-500 — likely pre-tokenization drift, not a separate intentional pattern). Per this repo's own strategy (code over Figma — Figma gets updated to match code, not the reverse), this real, cross-app pattern replaces the never-shipped Figma value as the canonical token. Not every input actually uses a ring at all — a plain border-color-only focus swap (no box-shadow) is actually the single most-repeated focus treatment by file count (recruitment-portal's entire shared Form component library, 14 files) — that lighter-weight treatment remains valid too, this token is for where a ring specifically is warranted.

small.$description: Confirmed via the Stat component's named 'Drop shadow/Small' variable.

medium.$description: Real-usage audit: weak-to-moderate — near-zero in most apps but a healthy 85 uses in dashboard specifically. Not dead, just unevenly adopted.

large.$description: Confirmed via the Tooltip component's named 'Drop shadow/Large' variable.

xlarge.$description: Confirmed twice — once via a named Figma variable, again via live design context on the Modal component (both Horizontal and Vertical alignment).

xxlarge.$description: Real-usage audit: dead as a named class in every one of the 5 apps checked — the least-evidenced token in this file. Kept for scale completeness; confirm it's still wanted before Phase 3.
